items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: What kind of stuff would you have to play to the band, I mean, with Celestan's band? ... Well, we played, when we first started out, it was popular music.

ctx.x: No, I just liked it. I didn't particularly take, you know, having one as an ideal. I just liked piano, liked music.
What kind of stuff would you have to play to the band, I mean, with Celestan's band? Just...

Well, we played, when we first started out, it was popular music. And then when we went into a large band, which was 14 pieces, then we played only arrangements. Strictly reading, all reading musicians. It was wonderful. We had a lovely large band.
